payload.recallText: About a family that was close to JFK, and they were close; they only lived 20 miles from each other, and after the assassination, news came out they cried in the car, including the father. We later travel to a time where the families no longer hung out and were forced to spy from the beach and discuss the Kens. Especially nosey aunts, at some point, the storyteller and the cousin got into a small boast and floated 5 min away in the vast waters. He is concerned no one paid attention to them, as they did not have life jackets, paddles, or anything to help them as kids, but the aunts were busy spying on the Kens
